REAL emulator physics (v8.8 rulebook baked in): wiring calls initWorld + per-body helpers; launch via 'launch:<id>' broadcast; reset = resetWorld (disable+rebuild), never destroy.
LIVE TEXT panel (2D windows composite as spatial panels). Spawns at the dock position — verify by turning the camera. Headless drive: DEBUG_CMD 'hud:<key>=<value>'.

Needs assets/menu.bundle (bake_textured_model of the 4-row panel, or copy a known-good one). The wiring attaches it on its own root + maps buttons via customActions; the mouse bridge clicks it. Broadcast start/pause/resume/reset also drives it.
Register each object; broadcast select = C0, controller/gaze ray = C3 (built-for-Swan).

meta.brief: A physics knockdown game: throw a ball at racked targets from a clickable menu, with a live THROWS scoreboard.

ledger.note: Emits SceneComposition.kt + HomeStage.kt + Main.kt from the spec; write all three (serial). No more hand-wiring.
Require BUILD SUCCESSFUL + PID up + ready-log before reading any capture (stale-APK gotcha).

howToExecute: Execute steps in `order`. After each generate_* returns Kotlin, WRITE it to `targetPath` yourself (serial edits — never fan out writers).

generate_app_wiring emits SceneComposition.kt + HomeStage.kt + Main.kt (the SpatialView.initial wiring, DEBUG_CMD dispatch, panel/menu attach) — write those three yourself; no hand-wiring of individual objects.
For data: SceneLayout.place(root, items.size) { i -> SceneDataBinding.makeCard(items[i]) }; then SceneInteraction.register(item.id, cardEntity) { id -> showDetail(id) }.
Then run the `build` step and confirm BUILD SUCCESSFUL + PID + ready-log before verify_app_spec.
